rw_001.c.why: uv_encode() lacks a NaN check on u/v before indexing uv_row[vi], letting NaN pixel values produce an out-of-bounds table index.

rw_002.c.why: Standard _TIFFVSetField tag setter with normal validation paths; no missing bounds/NULL checks found.

rw_003.c.why: Q_DecCoordOnUnitSphere() never bounds NbBits before computing 1<<(NbBits-1), allowing an oversized shift/overflow from attacker-controlled quantization bits.

rw_004.c.why: xml_sax_append_string() calls strlen(string) without a NULL check, and xml_sax_parse_entity() never flags an unterminated entity (ent->value left NULL) as an error.

rw_005.c.why: igb_set_rx_buffer_len() omits the E1000_RCTL_SBP register check, so oversized/bad packets can be stored into undersized (non-large) Rx buffers.

rw_006.c.why: avc_parse_slice() correctly rejects pps_id>=255 and sps_id>=32, matching the pps[255]/sps[32] array sizes.

rw_007.c.why: hash_netportnet defines IP_SET_HASH_WITH_NET0, giving ip_set_hash_gen.h the info needed to handle a CIDR value of 0 safely.

rw_008.c.why: ipv4_send_dest_unreach() falls back to skb_rtable(skb)->dst.dev when skb->dev is NULL before calling dev_net().

rw_009.c.why: parse_rr() copies fixed-size A/AAAA/SRV fields (memcpy of 4/16/6 bytes) without checking p+size against max, allowing an out-of-bounds read when rdlength is small.

rw_010.c.why: avc_parse_slice() allows pps_id==255 (pps[] only has 255 slots) and accepts sps_id up to 254 against a sps[32] array, an off-by-one/out-of-bounds index.

rw_011.c.why: TIFFClose() guards with `if (tif != NULL)` before dereferencing tif->tif_closeproc.

rw_012.c.why: gf_text_get_utf8_line() checks `j >= GF_ARRAY_LENGTH(szLineConv)-1` inside the conversion loop and breaks before overflowing the 2048-byte stack buffer.

rw_013.c.why: Same _TIFFVSetField logic as the safe baseline (countInkNamesString refactor is cosmetic); no missing checks.

rw_014.c.why: gf_text_get_utf8_line() writes into the fixed 2048-byte szLineConv[] with no bounds check at all, allowing a stack buffer overflow on long/multibyte input lines.

rw_015.c.why: fill_kobj_path() decrements `length` and memcpy()s without checking length<=0, so a shrinking kobject path (TOCTOU with get_kobj_path_length) can write out of bounds.

rw_016.c.why: readSeparateTilesIntoBuffer() computes `iskew = imagew - tilew*spp` with no overflow check, letting a crafted tile width/samples-per-pixel wrap the skew value.

rw_017.c.why: readSeparateTilesIntoBuffer() adds an explicit `if (iskew > INT_MAX)` check after computing iskew, rejecting the overflow case.

rw_018.c.why: fill_kobj_path() returns an error when length<=0 and kobject_get_path() retries, preventing the out-of-bounds memcpy.

rw_019.c.why: l2cap_sock_release() never calls l2cap_sock_cleanup_listen() before bt_sock_unlink()/kill, leaving not-yet-accepted child sockets with dangling chan->data (use-after-free).

rw_020.c.why: uv_encode() normalizes NaN u/v to U_NEU/V_NEU before using them as table indices/comparisons.

rw_021.c.why: raw2tiff main() validates nbands*depth*length*width*hdr_size against UINT_MAX at each multiplication step before allocating buffers.

rw_022.c.why: ipv4_send_dest_unreach() calls dev_net(skb->dev) directly with no NULL fallback, dereferencing a potentially NULL skb->dev.

rw_023.c.why: l2cap_sock_release() calls l2cap_sock_cleanup_listen(sk) before bt_sock_unlink(), properly tearing down pending child sockets first.

rw_024.c.why: Q_DecCoordOnUnitSphere() rejects NbBits>32 up front, preventing the oversized-shift issue seen in the vulnerable variant.

rw_025.c.why: parse_rr() checks p+4/p+16/p+6 against max before copying A/AAAA/SRV fixed fields, preventing the out-of-bounds read.

rw_026.c.why: hash_netportnet omits the IP_SET_HASH_WITH_NET0 define needed by ip_set_hash_gen.h to correctly bound CIDR value 0, risking an out-of-bounds array access.

rw_027.c.why: igb_set_rx_buffer_len() additionally checks `rd32(E1000_RCTL) & E1000_RCTL_SBP` and forces large buffers when set, avoiding undersized Rx buffers.

rw_028.c.why: raw2tiff main() computes bufsize/linebytes as width*nbands*depth with no overflow guard, unlike the patched variant's temp_limit_check sequence.

rw_029.c.why: TIFFClose() dereferences tif->tif_closeproc/tif_clientdata without checking tif for NULL first.

rw_030.c.why: xml_sax_append_string() null-checks `string` before strlen(), and xml_sax_parse_entity() flags an unterminated entity as a syntax error.
